title: Supergirl Candor TPB DC 2007 Collects Supergirl 6-9 Rucka Joe Kelly Churchill
conditionDescription: Covers bright with light edge and corner wear; light scuffing on the front cover; page edges lightly toned. Binding intact. See photos.
descriptionText:
Supergirl: Candor trade paperback (DC Comics, 2007), ISBN 978-1-4012-1226-1. Collects Supergirl #6-9 plus stories and excerpts from Superman, JLA, JSA Classified and Superman/Batman. Written by Greg Rucka and Joe Kelly, art by Ian Churchill and Ed Benes. Infinite Crisis and One Year Later: Supergirl and Power Girl in the Bottle City of Kandor. $14.99 cover price.

Condition: covers bright with light edge and corner wear and light scuffing on the front cover; page edges lightly toned (see edge and spine photos). Binding intact.

Ships in a protective mailer.
